subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Codex app-server connection establishment always fail after 30 seconds, or should the handshake deadline derive from the existing `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` or another owner-defined policy?
rationale: The mechanism fixes a real indefinite wait, but choosing an unconditional deadline changes availability for existing remote or slow app-server setups and is not determined by the upstream protocol.

options.title: Reuse existing timeout policy
options.body: Pass the resolved app-server timeout into WebSocket construction, with an owner-approved bound if needed, so operator timeout expectations remain coherent.

options.title: Approve fixed 30 seconds
options.body: Keep the proposed constant and explicitly accept that otherwise valid handshakes taking longer than 30 seconds will fail closed.

options.title: Add a connection-specific setting
options.body: Introduce a separate documented handshake timeout only if maintainers decide connection establishment needs policy independent from control-plane requests.

recommendation.title: Reuse existing timeout policy
recommendation.body: Pass the resolved app-server timeout into WebSocket construction, with an owner-approved bound if needed, so operator timeout expectations remain coherent.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server timeout, configuration, and live-validation work makes this the strongest available owner for the deadline policy.
